_readme: EVERY VALUE HERE IS ONE PROARC PUBLISHES ABOUT ITSELF (08-contact-data.md §1).
A third-party directory's account of ProArc is a CANDIDATE, and a candidate never
ships — it goes on the letter. The street address the 2GIS and FOB listings agree
on is therefore absent from this file by decision, not by oversight.
THE TWO GATES ARE THE TWO NULLS. There is no separate open/closed flag, because a
flag and a value can contradict each other and one of them would then be a lie:
street      null  -> X14 is open. The row is labelled Post and carries the PO
Box alone. Give this file a street and the row becomes
Address, in that order, with the PO Box beneath it.
hours.days  null  -> X15 is open. The Hours row is not rendered at all.
Give this file a day range and the row arrives.
NO BRACKETED DUMMY MAY EVER BE WRITTEN HERE. build/lib/contact.js throws on a
square bracket in any value. Brackets are a board and spec device (08-contact-data
§5); /careers shipped "[ Job Title ]" live to the public, and that is the fault
this build removes rather than repeats. A gate that is open renders NOTHING —
an absence is honest where a placeholder is not.
The tel: href is NOT authored. It is derived from phone by the build so the dialled
number and the printed number cannot drift apart.

published.poBox: P.O. Box 13003, Ajman, United Arab Emirates

how a site comes to disagree with itself about its own address.

_street_note: 🔴 RULED IN BY MAHESH, 9 Aug 2026 (Session XXXVII). X14 closes here.
This value was null BY DECISION for six days and the readme above still states the rule it
broke: a third-party directory's account of ProArc is a CANDIDATE. It ships now because Mahesh
ruled it in, not because the rule changed — and the ruling was the one letter item 6 asked for:
"say the word if you would rather the street address were published".
WHAT IS CORROBORATED BY PROARC'S OWN DATA, and what is not. proarc.ae/js/scripts.js publishes
the office pin — latLng [25.392760, 55.436931], "Our office - Ajman" — which is ProArc's own
statement about where ProArc is, and therefore confirmed data under 08-contact-data §1 rather
than a directory's claim. Against OpenStreetMap that point sits 96m from R Holding Tower and
139m from Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Street, so THE BUILDING AND THE STREET ARE CORROBORATED.
⚠️ "3rd Floor, Office 310" IS NOT. It comes from the FOB listing alone, and 2GIS disagrees with
the rest of that listing outright — it reads "R Holding, 87, Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed road" and
places the firm in Rashideya 3, ~1.1km from ProArc's own pin. The floor and office number are
the one fragment here that nothing ProArc publishes supports. Told to Mahesh before it shipped.
street: R Holding Building, 3rd Floor, Office 310, Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Road
_coords_note: ProArc's own published location, read off proarc.ae/js/scripts.js:312 on 9 Aug 2026.
The DIRECTIONS link is keyed on this and never on the street string, and the difference is the
whole point: v1's Get Directions asks Google Maps for "13003, Ajman, United Arab Emirates" —
the PO BOX, as though it were an address — and lands the reader on whatever Google guesses.
08-contact §7: "Broken by construction, not by a bad URL." A coordinate cannot be guessed at.
It is also why the link survives if the floor number above turns out to be wrong: the pin is
ProArc's, the street string is a caption on it.
